items.title: Texas A&M selects Dell Technologies to develop new AI supercomputing platform
items.summary: The Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station (TEES) has awarded Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) a contract to develop a new artificial intelligence and high-performance computing platform known as IGNITE, a project backed by funding from the State of Texas. The new infrastructure is expected to strengthen advanced research capabilities across multiple scientific, engineering and national security fields.

items.title: Malaysia's resource anxiety tests Asia's fastest data centre build-out
items.summary: After leapfrogging Singapore to become the region's fastest-growing data centre hub, Malaysia is facing intensifying scrutiny as the resources debate that has complicated the industry's growth spreads to emerging Asia.  Protests over a data centre complex in Johor state's southern tip — the epicentre of ‌the boom — were the first of their kind in the country.  "Two years ago, it was just about ‌building capacity," said Cheam Tat Inn, managing director at the Malaysian arm of U.S. data centre operator Equinix.
